source.title: WV DHHR Office of Laboratory Services Environmental Drinking Water Laboratory Certification Program — Laboratory Certified Parameter List PDF updated 8/20/2026 + OLS Environmental Microbiology / Environmental Chemistry private-well path + OEHS certified-labs listing page
limitations: OLS Laboratory Certified Parameter List PDF footer date Thursday, August 20, 2026 (104 pages). Primary source for roster.

PDF prints laboratory name, street address, city/state/ZIP, certificate ID, issue/expiration dates, and certified parameter groups — it does not print commercial phone numbers. Phone marked unknown for all commercial rows.

In-state municipal / utility / water-plant labs omitted from commercial table (AL/SD pattern): Beckley Water Company; Clarksburg Water Board; Fairmont Water Plant; Morgantown Utility Board Robert B. Creel Water Treatment Facility; Sweeneysburg Water Treatment Plant; Weirton Water Treatment Plant; Wheeling Water Treatment Plant; WVAWC Bluefield / Bluestone / Huntington / Kanawha Valley / Weston; WVAW-New River.

West Virginia Department of Agriculture / Moorefield Field Office (cert 00161M; Microbiology - Group I) omitted from commercial table as a state agriculture field office — not tabulated as commercial.
WV DOH OLS Chemistry (00003 C), OLS Microbiology (00003 M), and District Environmental Laboratory Kearneysville/Bardane (00005 M) documented in verified paths — not as commercial rows.
All 27 out-of-state labs on the 8/20/2026 PDF omitted from the main table — cite/link the official PDF.
Commercial private-well acceptance unknown for every commercial row — call first.

OLS Environmental Microbiology states the Unit tests water from private, individual households; private citizens should first contact their local county health department; OLS sterile bottles required; samples received/testing begun within 30 hours. Limited basis / prior arrangement for private citizens noted on the page.

OLS Environmental Chemistry states it provides support to private well owners; initial screening set includes total coliform, regulated metals, and combined nitrate + nitrite; bottles via 304-965-2694 or bottle request form (Apr 2026).
Fees appear on bottle-request / submission forms but are intentionally omitted from public HTML — confirm current amounts with OLS.
Older 5/14/2026 PDF not used (8/20/2026 PDF retrieved successfully).

verified_paths.name: WV DHHR Office of Laboratory Services — Environmental Microbiology (private / individual households)
verified_paths.notes: OLS states this Unit tests water from private, individual households (among other sources). Private citizens needing well water tested should first contact their local county health department so a sanitarian can collect the sample. Samples must use OLS-provided sterile containers (Bottle Request Form). Samples must be received and testing begun within 30 hours of collection. South Charleston Laboratory receives samples 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Mon–Fri (except state holidays); Bardane District Environmental Laboratory (Eastern panhandle counties) receives Mon–Wed 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. and Thu 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. Contacts printed on page: Water Testing 304-414-2432; Laboratory Certification 304-414-2435; Kearneysville (Bardane) 304-725-5832. OLS main office address on page: 167 11th Ave, South Charleston, WV 25303 · 304-558-3530. Certified list entries: OLS Microbiology 4710 Chimney Drive Suite G Charleston WV 25302 (cert 00003 M); District Environmental Laboratory 1948 Wiltshire Road Suite #7 Kearneysville WV 25430 (cert 00005 M).

verified_paths.name: WV DHHR Office of Laboratory Services — Environmental Chemistry (private well owners)
verified_paths.notes: OLS Environmental Chemistry states it provides support to private well owners (among OEHS, county health departments, Oral Health Program). Page recommends an initial set for private well owners: total coliform, regulated metals, and combined nitrate + nitrite. How to order sample bottles: telephone 304-965-2694 or bottle request form (Apr 2026 version linked). Contact: Environmental Chemistry Section, 4710 Chimney Drive, Suite G, Charleston, WV 25302 · Phone 304-965-2694 · Fax 304-965-2696. Certified list entry: OLS Chemistry cert 00003 C (Inorganics; Trace Metals). Fees intentionally omitted — confirm with OLS.
